notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.31: NEW KINKY CASE IS HERE!
notes.content:
Hello Vice Mayor,
Let's make two things on your daily schedule easier:

- Hold the scrolling! Supervise your empire of hotties with the Kinkverse filters in the Character Collection menu!
- The new Kinky Case won't just boost your profits - it's also a chance to unlock up to 3 rare event characters! 
Check the Shop each Tuesday to see what's good!
